regression_found_and_fixed.cause: Success notification woke the dispatcher before monitor cleanup and release of the current request slot
regression_found_and_fixed.fix: Release the owned generation scope and expected request slot before success/failure notification; cancellation still acknowledges immediately while cleanup remains owned

proven: Raw event transcript, copied name and arbitrary free-form context expire at the earliest actual source deadline, capped by source validation at 48 hours
Read-time SQL projection excludes expired text independently of the cleanup task; subsequent cleanup nulls raw fields and retains only explicitly allowed numeric diagnostic context
Numeric activity diagnostics retain their existing configured analytics lifetime, default 90 days; the persisted deadline cannot be renewed by reads, restart or a later configuration increase
Legacy events table rows remain unchanged and outside retrieval, distributions, sequences, statistics and cleanup of the active policy table
Unsourced writes cannot retain raw transcript, copied name or free-form context; activity identifiers and the diagnostic scalar channel are validated
Committed conversation revocation filters event analytics immediately before physical row cleanup and survives a fresh policy/logger instance
A native metric that outlives its observation budget cannot commit raw text after its source expires or is revoked
A native event commit ordered before a concurrent tombstone is no longer readable afterwards; a post-marker event writer is rejected
Actual diagnostic work remains bounded at eight operations after caller timeout, close reports retained work and subsequently waits for its actual exit
Runtime factory starts owned deadline-aware cleanup; its SQL event file is created with mode 0600 and SQLite connections close at the end of each operation
Both real voice routes preserve CommandEvent capture UUID and timestamp in event provenance, including when the memory catalogue is disabled; the orchestrated history uses that same capture source
Authenticated event APIs omit expired/revoked transcripts, perform actual event reads off-loop and apply Cache-Control no-store including authentication errors
Success and failure callbacks observe the released current-request slot and a closed generation stream/client; the two added regressions cover this ordering directly
The source-free CPython 3.13 runtime imports the actual event factory, stores a sourced event, excludes text at expiry and runs SQL cleanup
limits_and_remaining: H3 remains incomplete; there was no deployment, restart, HA action or migration/modification of real private legacy data
This covers logical SQL projection, raw-field cleanup and event deletion; it does not claim forensic erasure of database storage media
